title: Same Letters
statement: Two words are made of lowercase letters. Return true if one word uses exactly the same letters as the other, the same number of times each (an anagram), otherwise false.

answerKey.pattern: Count letters with a hash map (or an array of 26 counters) and compare
keyPoints: If the lengths differ, return false
Add 1 for each letter of the first word
Subtract 1 for each letter of the second word
Return true only if every count is 0
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sort both words and compare: O(n log n)

hints: Sorting both words works. Can you count letters instead?
Keep a count for each letter: up for the first word, down for the second.
Check the lengths first, then make sure every count ends at zero.
